name: B10-0474/2025 (ESN) – Renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from the ESN Group. It does not change any law. It sets out what the group wants the EU to demand at the EU–Africa summit in Luanda, Angola, on 24–25 November 2025. It asks for development money to depend on African countries taking back their citizens who are in the EU without permission, and on better treatment of Christians. It also wants the EU's partnership with South Africa made conditional on protecting the Boer minority.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** African Union states, South Africa, and EU aid and migration policy.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament votes on the text; the summit follows on 24–25 November 2025.
